cards.text:
V-TD05/001EN
Hexagonal Magus
Normal Unit｜ Oracle Think Tank｜ Grade 3｜ Power 12000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], look at two cards from the top of your deck, put them on the top of your deck in any order, and draw a card.
[AUTO](VC/RC):When your drive check reveals a trigger unit, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

V-TD05/002EN
Miko of the Treasured Sword, Shizuki
Normal Unit｜ Oracle Think Tank｜ Grade 3｜ Power 12000｜ Shield -
[ACT](RC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 2 & Soul-Blast 1], draw a card, and three units in your front row get [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

V-TD05/003EN
Battle Sister, Orangette
Normal Unit｜ Oracle Think Tank｜ Grade 2｜ Power 12000｜ Shield -
-

V-TD05/004EN
Rectangle Magus
Normal Unit｜ Oracle Think Tank｜ Grade 2｜ Power 9000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When placed, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Soul-Blast 1], look at two cards from the top of your deck, put them on the top of your deck in any order, and draw a card.
[AUTO](RC):When your drive check reveals a trigger unit, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

V-TD05/005EN
Miko of Spiritual Light, Kinuka
Normal Unit｜ Oracle Think Tank｜ Grade 2｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When you draw a card, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn. (Does not activate from drive check or "put" effects)

V-TD05/006EN
Cuore Magus
Normal Unit｜ Oracle Think Tank｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, look at two cards from the top of your deck, and put them on the top of your deck in any order. ・iWhen ridden on Lozenge Magus, activate their abilities in any order you wish)

V-TD05/007EN
Ripis Magus
Normal Unit｜ Oracle Think Tank｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When it boosts, if you have a vanguard with "Magus" in its card name, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle.

V-TD05/008EN
Ruote Magus
Normal Unit｜ Oracle Think Tank｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO](GC):When placed, [COST][discard a card from your hand], and one of your units cannot be hit until end of that battle.

V-TD05/009EN
Weal Crane
Normal Unit｜ Oracle Think Tank｜ Grade 1｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When you draw a card, [COST][put this unit into your soul], and two rear-guards in your front row get [Power] +10000 until end of turn. (Does not activate from drive check or "put" effects)

V-TD05/010EN
Lozenge Magus
Normal Unit｜ Oracle Think Tank｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO]:When rode upon, draw a card.
